summary: Advanced contact centre operations management training. Master Erlang C, COPC, WFM scheduling and AI routing. Build dashboards and roadmaps you can implement im
lede: Contact Centre Operations Management brings staffing, technology, and processes together to support service-level compliance, cost control, and stronger customer experiences. This course helps you use Erlang C, create capacity plans from historical call data, build dynamic schedules, and monitor real-time adherence. You will develop practical skills in quality assurance calibration, COPC- and ISO 18295-aligned scorecards, adherence audits, executive dashboards, and AI-assisted routing. The course also introduces predictive forecasting at an overview level and explores how AI automation and hybrid agent models are influencing shift planning and quality monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course targets experienced professionals who run daily contact centre operations.
prerequisites: Minimum three years managing or analysing contact centre operations. Working knowledge of basic metrics (AHT, SL, occupancy) and spreadsheet modelling required. No coding needed.
